body: Forward test of the promise-tracker credibility method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.58 (naive base rate 0.50) that: Five Below FY2026 comparable sales growth is ≥+11.0% (midpoint of its 10–12% outlook). Evidence: 8-K 2-Sep-2026 (Q2 FY26): net sales +22.9% to $1.26B, comps +14.1%; double-digit comps for five straight quarters; FY26 comps outlook raised to +10–12% (prior +6–8%), net sales $5.63–5.71B (prior $5.40–5.48B), Q3 comps guide +8–10%; outlook excludes future tariff refunds and buybacks. Q3 results due early Dec-2026 (before resolution). Reasoning: The guide implies a sharp H2 deceleration from a +14% Q2; management has beaten and raised, which usually signals conservative H2 assumptions. Resolution: YES if Five Below's reported FY2026 (year ending ~Jan-2027) comparable sales increase (Q4 FY26 earnings release) ≥ +11.0%. Source: Five Below Q4 FY2026 earnings 8-K (SEC EDGAR, CIK 1177609). Resolve by 2027-03-31; score with Brier vs base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: Coin-flip for landing above a guidance midpoint absent track record (~50%).
